# 8.css

> A CSS-only Windows 8 UI library, strongly inspired by 7.css by khang-nd and evolved from an old Windows 8 Start Screen demo.

8.css styles semantic HTML without a required JavaScript runtime. It targets Windows 8 Modern UI / Start Screen and desktop components.

## Source layout
- gui/*.css: maintained component modules.
- src/8.css: generated combined source.
- dist/8.css: complete distribution bundle.
- dist/gui/*.css: modular CSS distribution.
- docs/index.html: navigable catalog with live previews and copyable examples.
- AGENTS.md and llms-full.txt: coding-agent guidance.

## Principles
- Keep Windows 8 Start Screen and desktop UI recognizable.
- Use w8- class names to reduce collisions.
- Keep the library CSS-only at runtime.
- Use semantic HTML, visible focus, and reduced-motion support.
- Do not claim CSS implements tab, window, or application behavior.

## Installation target
After the first public npm release, install with npm install 8.css and import 8.css/dist/8.css. The package has not been published yet; verify that the unscoped name is available before the first release.
